answer: Behavioral fingerprint clustering. Post-hoc, agents' action sequences are encoded as timing vectors and operation mixes, then hashed per interaction graph into a signed cipher. Clusters sharing a near-identical vector but distinct identities get flagged. As a second layer, a trellis of pairwise co-occurrence windows tracks which identities always move together; edges above threshold mark probable puppets.
